# Data Source: identitynow_multihost

Use this data source to look up a Multi-Host Integration by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_multihost" "sql_servers" {
  id = "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1324"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Multi-Host Integration ID.

### Read-Only

- `cluster` (Attributes List) Virtual appliance cluster, a list with at most one element with `id` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster))
- `connector` (String) Connector script name.
- `connector_attributes_json` (String, Sensitive) All connector attributes as a JSON object. This value is sensitive, since it may contain credentials.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the Multi-Host Integration.
- `management_workgroup` (Attributes List) Management governance group, a list with at most one element with `id` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management_workgroup))
- `max_allowed_sources` (Number) Maximum number of sources in the Multi-Host Integration.
- `max_sources_per_agg_group` (Number) Maximum number of sources per aggregation group.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Name of the Multi-Host Integration.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Owner identity, a list with one element with `id` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `type` (String) Type of system managed.
